before: **Private use of business assets.** Withdrawal of business goods under § 3(1b) UStG, and private use of an allocated business asset under § 3(9a) no. 1 UStG, are deemed supplies only where the goods or relevant components entitled the business to full or partial input deduction. For asset use, the exclusions in § 3(9a) no. 1 for § 15(1b) and § 15a(6a) also apply. Other free services under § 3(9a) no. 2 have their own rule. Report a taxable deemed supply at the applicable rate, normally in Kz 81. For a goods withdrawal the base is the purchase price of the item or an equivalent item, plus incidental costs, or otherwise cost, at the withdrawal date (§ 10(4) no. 1). For asset use it is the expenses that entitled the business to input deduction; acquisition or production costs of at least EUR 500 are spread over the applicable § 15a correction period (§ 10(4) no. 2), rather than using the income-tax list-price figure. A motor vehicle is not blocked for VAT: the business share decides the deduction, and below 10% business use there is none.
after: **Private use of business assets.** Withdrawal of business goods under § 3(1b) UStG is a deemed supply only where the goods or their components entitled the business to full or partial input deduction. Private use of an allocated business asset under § 3(9a) no. 1 UStG requires that the asset entitled the business to full or partial input deduction. For asset use, the exclusions in § 3(9a) no. 1 for § 15(1b) and § 15a(6a) also apply. Other free services under § 3(9a) no. 2 have their own rule. Report a taxable deemed supply at the applicable rate, normally in Kz 81. For a goods withdrawal the base is the purchase price of the item or an equivalent item, plus incidental costs, or otherwise cost, at the withdrawal date (§ 10(4) no. 1). For asset use it is the expenses that entitled the business to input deduction; acquisition or production costs of at least EUR 500 are spread over the applicable § 15a correction period (§ 10(4) no. 2), rather than using the income-tax list-price figure. A motor vehicle is not blocked for VAT: allocation and business use decide the deduction, and below 10% business use there is none.
